items.text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO LOCAL GOVERNMENT

items.actClause: AN ACT creating the Seymour public library district in the towns of Sweden and Clarkson, New York including the Village of Brockport; and to amend chapter 672 of the laws of 1993 amending the public authorities law relating to the construction and financing of facilities for certain public libraries, in relation to including the Seymour public library district within the provisions of such chapter and providing for financing through the dormitory authority
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S4116

TITLE OF BILL:

An act creating the Seymour public library district in the towns of
Sweden and Clarkson, New York including the Village of Brockport; and
to amend chapter 672 of the laws of 1993 amending the public
authorities law relating to the construction and financing of
facilities for certain public libraries, in relation to including the
Seymour public library district within the provisions of such chapter
and providing for financing through the dormitory authority

PURPOSE:

To create the Seymour public library district serving the Towns of
Sweden and Clarkson, as well as the Village of Brockport.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 is the creation of the Seymour public library district
serving the Towns of Sweden and Clarkson, as well as the Village of
Brockport.

Section 2 allows for the election of the district and all the laws
related to its creation. Allows for the election of nine trustees.

Section 3 allows for the organization and structure.

Section 4 allows the voters to set the budget and funding for the
budget. The initial budget shall be determined by a vote of the voters
of the district. All future budgets that increase or decrease shall be
submitted annually to the voters.

Section 5 allows for the charter, commencement of operations and
transfer of property and employees.

Section 6 allows for ad valorem levy.

Section 7 States that unless otherwise provided the education law
relating to libraries shall be applicable to the district.

Section 8 deems the district a special district.

Section 9 adds Seymour. Public Library to the list of public libraries
under the public authorities law.

Section 10 is the effective date.

JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation has been asked for by the current Seymour Library. As
the current district serves three various municipalities and it not a
special library district, the administration of the library is
cumbersome. For one example, should any of the three municipalities
vote down the current budget (which is the same for all three
municipalities) the budget fails, even if it passes in both other
municipalities. This legislation simply seeks to add the Seymour


public library district to the list of those other special districts
currently in existence.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

FISCAL IMPACT ON THE STATE:

None.

EFFECTIVE DATE:

This act shall take immediately.
